text: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问。美方隆重热烈接待，两国元首亲切互动，就关乎两国关系和世界局势的重大问题进行坦诚深入交流，达成很多新的共识，同意进一步丰富中美关系定位的内涵，共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”。这是一次举世瞩目、成果丰硕的访问，为中美关系提供了新的战略指引，进一步拓展了双方交流合作空间，为两国人民增进福祉，为世界和平增添希望。
text_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Trump, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25. The U.S. side gave a grand and warm reception, and the two heads of state interacted cordially, engaging in candid and in-depth exchanges on major issues concerning bilateral relations and the world situation, reaching many new consensus points and agreeing to further enrich the connotation of the positioning of China-U.S. relations and jointly build a "constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and mutual reciprocity." This was a visit that attracted worldwide attention and produced fruitful results, providing new strategic guidance for China-U.S. relations, further expanding space for exchanges and cooperation between the two sides, enhancing the well-being of the two peoples, and adding hope for world peace.
